item.title: If the Source Isn't Cleared, the Best Antibiotic Won't Save You: Notes from an ED Antibiotics Seminar
item.description: I went to an ED antibiotics seminar (the ER & GIGS Joint Academic Symposium): four talks plus a new sedative. The whole time I was listening I had this feeling: the topics looked like they had nothing to do with each other (fever in chemo patients, cholangitis, complicated infections in the belly), but underneath they were all saying the same thing: if the source of infection isn't cleared, no matter how beautifully you pick the antibiotic, it's all for nothing.
